chunks: And Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام said:
When the shares are divided, the right of preemption is annulled.

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, Imam Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī al-Bāqir عليه السلام
key_terms.ارْتَفَعَتِ: ceased, was lifted, or came to an end
key_terms.السِّهَامُ: the apportioned shares or divided portions of property
key_terms.الشُّفْعَةُ: the right of preemption in a shared property transaction

ai.seo_question: When does the right of preemption (shuf'ah) end in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning shuf'ah, the right of preemption in jointly held property. It indicates that once the shares have been allocated and separated, the basis for claiming shuf'ah no longer remains.
